bulletins.title: FTC Impersonators Threaten Phone Number Deactivation
bulletins.summary: Scammers call pretending to be Federal Trade Commission officials, reading fake badge numbers. They claim a phone was registered in the victim's name to commit crimes abroad and threaten immediate deactivation if the victim does not cooperate.

bulletins.title: Charity Impersonators Claiming Sweepstakes Winnings
bulletins.summary: Callers pose as representatives of reputable charities that the victim previously supported. They claim the victim won a special charity sweepstakes contest and use this pretense to solicit personal information or advance fees.

bulletins.title: Account Takeover via Fraudulent Verification Code Requests
bulletins.summary: Fraudsters trigger legitimate multi-factor authentication passcodes to a victim's phone after harvesting credentials. They immediately call or text posing as security representatives, asking the victim to read back the code to confirm account access.

gemini_context_snippet: Watch for phone calls claiming to be government officials threatening phone deactivation over international crimes. Beware callers impersonating familiar charities announcing fake sweepstakes prizes, as well as callers posing as security representatives demanding one-time verification passcodes.
